# Saudi Regulations Arabic Retrieval Benchmark · v1.0.0

> مجموعة بيانات لاسترجاع المواد النظامية السعودية بالعربية، مع تطبيق التعديلات النظامية وتوثيق حالة كل مادة.

Arabic retrieval corpus of Saudi regulations for HR, legal and compliance use. Every article carries its **status as current law**, because the official portal publishes the original wording and attaches amendments as notes.

**Generated by `make dataset`. Do not edit by hand.**

## Contents

| Law | in_force | amended | review_needed | repealed | superseded | Total | Chunks |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| نظام العمل (`labor-law`) | 140 | 53 | 18 | 29 | 12 | 252 | 212 |
| نظام حماية البيانات الشخصية (`pdpl`) | 19 | 12 | 11 | 1 | 0 | 43 | 43 |
| نظام الشركات (`companies-law`) | 281 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 281 | 285 |

`corpus.jsonl` holds the 534 current articles; `history.jsonl` holds the 42 repealed or superseded ones (ids end in `@repealed` / `@superseded`).

## Why amendment resolution matters

- **نظام العمل**: 50 of 211 current articles have a text in force that differs from the article body the portal displays.
- **نظام حماية البيانات الشخصية**: 12 of 42 current articles have a text in force that differs from the article body the portal displays.
- **نظام الشركات**: 0 of 281 current articles have a text in force that differs from the article body the portal displays.

### Amendment notes by kind

A note attached to several articles (e.g. a consolidation) is counted once per article.

| Law | replace | add | repeal | renumber | consolidate | partial |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `labor-law` | 56 | 10 | 30 | 0 | 17 | 21 |
| `pdpl` | 12 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 0 | 11 |
| `companies-law` | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Article status

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `in_force` | Never amended; the published text is in force. |
| `amended` | Amended; the text is the latest full wording from the amendment notes. |
| `review_needed` | A partial amendment (one paragraph or phrase) is not applied yet; the text is the last certain version and the note is attached. |
| `repealed` | Repealed; in `history.jsonl`, not in the corpus. |
| `superseded` | Folded into other articles by a consolidation; its number now belongs to the new article. In `history.jsonl`, not in the corpus. |

## Schema (`corpus.jsonl` and `history.jsonl`, BEIR format)

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `_id` | Stable article id, e.g. `labor-law:79-bis` |
| `title` | Citation, e.g. `نظام العمل — المادة الأولى` |
| `text` | Text in force (see `metadata.status`) |
| `metadata.law_id`, `law_title` | The law |
| `metadata.article_number`, `bis` | Official number; `bis` marks a مكرر article |
| `metadata.heading`, `article_title` | Heading, and the article's own title if any |
| `metadata.part`, `chapter` | Location in the law (الباب / الفصل) |
| `metadata.status` | One of the statuses above |
| `metadata.original_text` | Originally published wording (`null` if added later) |
| `metadata.amendments[]` | `kind`, `decree`, `issued`, `effective` (Hijri), `note` |
| `metadata.source_url` | Official page |

- **نظام الشركات**: <https://laws.boe.gov.sa/BoeLaws/Laws/LawDetails/a8376aea-1bc3-49d4-9027-aed900b555af/1> (snapshot 2026-10-07)

## How it was built

1. Official HTML pages are fetched (honouring `Crawl-delay: 10`), validated by parsing, and kept as gzip snapshots with SHA-256 manifests in `data/sources/boe/`.
2. Each article block is parsed (heading, body, amendment notes, part, chapter); Arabic ordinal headings are converted to numbers.
3. Amendment notes are classified from the text *outside* their quoted new wording (replace, add, repeal, renumber, consolidate, partial) and applied in decree-date order. Only unambiguous amendments are applied; partial ones, notes listing several edits, and undated competing texts mark the article `review_needed`.
4. Integrity check: no two current articles of a law may share a number.

## Limitations

- **Not an official consolidation and not legal advice.** Verify against the official source before relying on any article.
- `review_needed` articles show the last certain wording, not the current one.
- Amendment notes are classified by rules over free text; an unrecognized note is always treated as partial (never applied), which is the safe failure mode.
- Queries and relevance judgments (`queries.jsonl`, `qrels/`) are being added in the next release.

## License and use

The law texts are official public documents published by the Bureau of Experts at the Council of Ministers (هيئة الخبراء بمجلس الوزراء). This dataset adds structure, amendment resolution and metadata for research and evaluation.
